question: How does universal identity with Kālī negate all difference?
premises: Everything became Kālī and is full.
Where all is Kālī, no division remains.
The address to the great goddess affirms this unity.
inference: Therefore no difference exists within the all-encompassing reality of Kālī.
plain_english: All became Kālī and is full; there is no difference, O great goddess.
